summary: Executed backend pytest API suite and frontend Playwright E2E for Arabic bank deposit app. Core flows pass: bank selection, per-bank registration, DB save, data isolation, current/previous year reports, and invalid maturity-date rejection.

ui_bugs.issue: Console hydration warning: <span> rendered inside <option> element ('In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option>').

action_items: Fix hydration warning in report deposit <select>/<option> rendering to avoid future UI instability.
Populate /app/memory/test_credentials.md when auth credentials are introduced (currently empty).
critical_code_review_comments: Frontend currently logs a structural HTML/hydration warning in ReportPage options; should be resolved before production hardening.
Backend and frontend env usage is correct (REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL and MONGO_URL/DB_NAME), and Mongo _id is properly excluded from API responses.
test_credentials: File /app/memory/test_credentials.md exists but has no credentials content.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_/UI prefixed deposits for banque-misr, agricultural-bank, and industrial-development during API/UI runs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression tests are now available at /app/backend/tests/test_deposit_interest_api.py and passed on public URL from frontend/.env. UI E2E passed functional requirements; only known issue is report selector hydration warning visible in browser console.
rca of the issue: Reproduction: open any report page and inspect browser console. Root cause: invalid DOM structure during option rendering where tooling/instrumentation injects span-like wrappers inside <option> content. Mitigation: ensure plain text node rendering inside <option> (no wrapped JSX/metadata-emitting transforms).
